description: This Dart source file provides testing utility functions for Flutter widget tests, including setup for sqflite FFI, frame pumping, waiting for widget conditions, unmounting widget trees, and cleaning up dependencies.

methods.name: initSqfliteFfiForTests
methods.description: Initializes the sqflite plugin to use the FFI implementation for testing, ensuring tests do not hang due to missing platform implementations.

methods.name: pumpFrames
methods.description: Pumps a fixed number of Flutter frames with a specified duration, useful for advancing animations or microtask processing in tests.

methods.name: assertNoScheduledFramesAfterPumps
methods.description: Pumps frames and asserts that the Flutter framework has no scheduled frames afterward, verifying that the app is idle.

methods.name: pumpAndSettleBounded
methods.description: Pumps frames until the framework becomes idle or a timeout occurs, with a bounded number of attempts to prevent hanging.

methods.name: pumpUntilFound
methods.description: Continuously pumps frames until a specific widget is found or a timeout occurs.

methods.name: pumpUntilNoScheduledFrames
methods.description: Pumps frames until no frames are scheduled or until a timeout, preventing hangs caused by ongoing timers or animations.

methods.name: unmountWidgetTree
methods.description: Removes the current widget tree and waits for the app to settle, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: disposeAppDependencies
methods.description: Cleans up application dependencies by canceling downloads, closing the database, and other cleanup routines.
